payload.title: Run the seed-1 live rounds and the paper-600 comparison on Jev
payload.description:
## Purpose

Live seed-1 run of arms 0 / A / B-local / B / A+B on Jev `jev-1.13.0`.

## Done

3 × 100 labels, iteration on dev-100 (2,400 Jev requests), final frozen comparison on paper-600 (3,600 Jev requests); about 6,000 in all, under the 9,500-request ($5) ceiling. Analyst calls (OpenAI `gpt-6-luna`) small and not counted. Text-free summaries: `studies/results/unified/seed1.dev100.summary.json`, `seed1.paper600.summary.json` (commit 33f2afe).
